title: Tha sahara aik hi Abbas ka
body:
THA SAHARA AIK HI ABBAS KA
Karbala hai Faqr-e-Shah-e-Mustafa
Uthgaya sar faqr se islam ka
Sar jhukate hain yahan bhi ambiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kardiya tumne bhi apna haq ada
Karbala ka zarra zarra hai gawah
Aal-e-Ahmed ka yahan par sar kata
Sani-e-Zehra ki chhinti hai rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Hashr tak aati rahegi ye sada
Dekh uthke aye nigehbane haram
Kis ghazab ke hai yahan zulm-o-sitam
Tumhi batlao pukare kisko hum
<<DIVIDER>>
Shumr hai durra liye hum par badha
Ye zamee’n-o-aasmaa’n hilne lage
Sunke Zainab ki sada rone lage
Zulm hum par baniye shar ne kiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya qata thi koi batlaye zara
Umm-e-Laila ka jigar tukde huwa
Beqata Shashmaha bhi maara gaya
Maang ujdi aur jhoola bhi jala
<<DIVIDER>>
Deti hai har waqt Laila ye sada
Qasim ibn Hasan paamal hai
Qatl Zainab ke huwe hai laadle
Bekafan laashe rahe run mein pade
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek hi din mein qatima sab ka huwa
Ab paresha’n Zainab-e-Dilgeer hai
Tegh hai shamsheer naiza teer hai
Nargha-e-Aada mein ab Shabbir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Saqt mushkil mein hai bhai ab mera
Sham hote hi badhe zulm-o-jafa
Ab dhuwa’n qaime se Sarwar ke utha
Abid-e-Beemar ka bistar jala
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch khabar tumko nahi hai bawafa
Shab Gharebo’n ki andheri raat hai
Dekhti Zainab jali qannath hai
Phir se dushman ne lagaye ghaath hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Leli Zainab tumne bhai ki jagah
Karbala se shaam ke zindaan tak
Taaza mehshar tha bapa maidan tak
Bhool baithe ummati ehsaan tak
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbadar Shabbir ka kunba huwa
Dhoop ki shiddat wo pani ki kami
Rote rote thi na palko par nami
Ek tamasha bangayi thi zindagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aik chaadar ka mila na aasra
Zainab-o-Kulsoom ke bazu bandhe
Ek rasan mein bandhgaye baara gale
Kaise kaise zulm jo hum par huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
Hota hai aisa kisi par zulm kiya
Hum Hussaini ko hai Zehra ki dua
Matam-e-Sarwar ka dengi wo sila
Qadm-e-Moula honge jannat mein jaga
<<DIVIDER>>
Anjuman ko mil gaya sadqa tera
Haye wo zindaan ke ranj-o-alam
Qaid mein Allah re zulm-o-sitam
Tha kahan jaana kahan par aaye hum
<<DIVIDER>>
Poochne wala koi ab na raha
Tumko Agha hai ye moula ki ataa
Naam-e-Sarwar par ho teri jaa’n fida
Tumko dar se Shah ke kya kya mila
<<DIVIDER>>
Shai ki marqad par ho tera Haj ada
